description: Luau (Roblox / Typed Lua) development: gradual nominal and structural type system, vector math optimizations, sandboxed runtime security, and strict linter compliance.
instructionsMarkdown:
# Luau High-Performance Typed Scripting

Develop robust, statically-typed Luau code for Roblox engines and sandboxed game systems.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Enforce `--!strict` mode at the top of every module.
- Provide explicit return and argument types on all exported functions; forbid `any`.
- Minimize heap allocations in per-frame step functions by reusing `Vector3` and `CFrame` instances.
- Ensure all modules run hermetically within the sandboxed Luau environment.
